name: Hardcoded Transfer Function
aliases: 1D Lookup Table with Interpolation > Lookup Table Implementation > Hardcoded Transfer Function — Fixed RGBA Array, Static 1D Lookup Table, 1D Transfer Function
definition: A 1D lookup table defining color and opacity as a function of scalar value, stored as a static float array.
summary: A Hardcoded Transfer Function maps scalar intensity directly to fixed RGBA values via a static lookup table, lacking the gradient-based disambiguation of 2D transfer functions.
